title: Mughal Society The Ruling Classes
definition: The Mughal ruling class, primarily the 'Mansabdars', was a heterogeneous, meritocratic, and state-dependent elite group that functioned as the backbone of the imperial administrative and military apparatus.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Mansabdari System', socio-political integration of Rajputs/Deccanis, and the structural causes of the Mughal decline (Jagirdari crisis).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Mughal Society The Ruling Classes.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Mughal administrative hierarchy
Concept of Centralized vs. Decentralized authority
